answer: Chained work gate: each agent must forge a 200-task hash chain seeded by the prior agent's output before transacting. This is no fable of cheap parallelism—N attacker identities force N serial chains, multiplying wall-clock time linearly per batch. One hollow identity costs a single chain; a 1,000-identity swarm costs 1,000 serial chains, roughly 40 GPU-hours before any transaction clears.
